name: Roulette Challenge
description: Spin a roulette before a level and play it with one of 100 random handicaps. Clear the goal to win points.

safe-mode.name: Photosensitive safe mode
safe-mode.description: Never roll challenges with fast flashing or fast spinning.

spicy.name: Spicy odds
spicy.description: Epic and Legendary challenges show up much more often.

hud.name: Challenge HUD
hud.description: Show the active challenge and goal while playing.

chaos-seconds.name: Chaos mode (seconds)
chaos-seconds.description: If above 0, the handicap changes to a new random one every this many seconds.
